newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Earnings, warnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Earnings, warnings.

text.p: ATL ULTRASOUND INC - Late Monday, the company said it expects to report a third quarter loss of $0.10 to $0.20 per share, on revenues of $90 to $95 million. The stock dropped 8-7/8 to 33-3/4.
COMPUTER TASK GROUP INC - posted second quarter earnings of $0.25 a share compared to $0.15 a share last year on a 9.6 percent increase in revenues. Up 2-11/16 to 40-3/4.
JOHNSON & JOHNSON - posted second quarter earnings of $0.68 a share compared to $0.60 last year on a six percent increase in sales. Up 11/16 to 63-5/8.
WELLS FARGO AND CO - posted second quarter earnings of $2.49 a share, down from $3.61 a share last year on lower net interest income. Up 1-1/8 to 266-5/8 after falling as low

BOISE CASCADE OFFICE PRODUCTS CORP - posted second quarter earnings of $0.19 a share compared to $0.22 per share. Said weak paper market, competitive pressures offset 30 percent increase in sales. Up 5/8 to 16-3/4.
TRAVELERS GROUP INC - posted second quarter operating earnings of $0.99 a share compared to $0.86 a share on a 10 percent increase in revenues. Up 11/16 to 65-7/8.

PERIPHONICS CORP - reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.30 a share compared to $0.25 a share, revenues increased 1 3 percent. Periphonics also said it believes a revenue growth rate of between 20 and 25 percent is an achievable target for fiscal 1998. Down 4-7/8 to 16.
APPLIED MAGNETICS CORP - reported third quarter earnings of $0.75 per diluted share compared to $0.10 per diluted share a year ago. Sales rose 68 percent. Up 1-3/16 to 30-3/16.
RAYONIER INC - Second quarter earnings increase to $0.67 a share from $0.51 a share last year despite slight decline in revenues. Up 15/16 to 44-13/16.
SANMINA CORP -- Late on Monday, Sanmina posted third quarter earnings of $0.54 a share compared to $0.40 a share last year. Down 1-1/4 to 673/8.
TEXAS INSTRUMENTS INC - Posted stronger-than-expected second quarter earnings, strong semiconductor revenues and higher operating margins. Up 10-1/8 to 107-5/8.

ENRON CORP - posts second quarter operating earnings of $0.40 a share compared to $0.46 a share a year ago. Enron also trimmed its internal earnings target for 1997 by $0.30 a share to about $2.25 per primary share. The company also authorized the repurchase of 10 million shares during the second half. Down 2-1/8 to 38-1/8.
TERADYNE INC - Reported second quarter operating earnings of $0.33 a share compared to $0.50 a share last year. Sales dropped about 9.4 percent. Teradyne lost 3 to 46.
DOVER CORP - Second quarter earnings increased to $0.89 a share, up from $0.78 a share last year. Sales rose 13 percent. Up 2-7/16 to 65-5/8.
FRESH AMERICA CORP - Company said that it and Tom Lange Co terminated their merger plans, which were announced less than a month ago. Down 1-3/4 to 18.
CERPROBE CORP - Second quarter earnings increased to $0.24 a share from $0.15 a share last year. Sales rose 93 percent. Up 3-7/8 to 17-7/8.
COMPUTER TASK GROUP INC - Late Monday, the company posted second quarter earnings of $0.25 a share compared to $0.15 a share last year. Revenues increased bout 9.6 percent. Up 3-1/16 to 41-1/8.
